# Known limitations (read before relying on the output)

## Evidence limits
* **Synthetic data only.** Every benchmark and test document was generated by this repository. Results say nothing certain about real invoices, statements, forms or scans, which are messier (stamps, logos, coloured backgrounds, handwriting, merged cells, rotated pages, mixed languages).
* **Single environment.** Developed and tested on Linux, Python 3.13, Tesseract 5.3.4, 2 vCPU. **Not tested on Windows**, on Python 3.11/3.12, on macOS, or on real Android/iPhone/tablet browsers. The UI was exercised only with headless Chromium (phone-sized and desktop viewports).
* **Validator tuned on its own test set.** Precision/recall on the 10 labelled tables (7 injected anomalies) was reached after fixing false positives found on those same tables; it is a development-set figure, not a generalisation estimate.
* **No video** of the demo was recorded (not possible in this environment).
* **50-page support** is evidenced by two runs (digital and scanned, 50 pages each) of one synthetic layout — see `reports/`. Other 50-page documents, especially scanned ones on slower CPUs, may hit the 900 s per-document budget (then remaining pages are marked failed and the result PARTIAL). Memory use was not measured.

## Functional limits
* **Wrapped cell text in un-ruled tables** becomes extra rows (cells beyond the first line land in new rows). They are flagged (`possible_wrapped_text`) but not merged. Ruled tables with wrapped text work (pdfplumber reads the whole cell).
* **Narrow gutters.** Columns separated by less than ~0.6 × the text height cannot be told apart in un-ruled/OCR tables and will merge into one column.
* **Merged/spanning cells, nested tables, multi-row headers** are not modelled; a two-line header is read as two rows (the second becomes a data row).
* **A table fragment that is a single un-ruled row alone on a page** is not detected by the geometry strategy.
* **Rotated pages** (page rotation ≠ 0) are not explicitly handled.
* **Poor scans** are rejected (page mean OCR confidence < 35/100) rather than guessed; scans between 35 and ~60 may contain many wrong characters — those rows are flagged (`low_ocr_confidence`) but the characters themselves are not verified.
* **OCR language:** English (`eng`) only. Other languages need Tesseract language data and a change to `Settings.ocr_lang`.
* **Heuristic scores** (0‥1) are rules of thumb. They are never presented as accuracy or probability.
* **Automatic corrections** are limited to two OCR repair rules in numeric columns of OCR cells. Everything else is flagged, not fixed.
* **Totals check** is applied only to rows labelled "Total/Subtotal/Grand total" in numeric columns, comparing against the sum of the rows above; it cannot verify totals that use other labels or weighted/percentage logic.
* **Date handling:** unambiguous formats are converted to Excel dates; `dd/mm` vs `mm/dd` is decided per column only when a value > 12 settles it; two-digit years stay text.
* **Number formats:** western and Indian digit grouping only; European `1.234,56` stays text (flagged in numeric columns).
* **Encrypted PDFs** are rejected (no password prompt). **Per-document concurrency** is limited to 2 jobs in the web app.
* **Hosted privacy:** see `docs/deployment.md` — retention on a hosting platform is outside the app's control.
